title: 长端利率的锚没了：AI融资狂潮逼出真相，财政部也拦不住
speaker: Mark Conan

segments.en: and despite this intervention that the treasury is trying to do on the long end you know you see the bond vigilante is trying to in some ways yes protest that
segments.zh: 尽管财政部试图干预长端，但债券义警在某种程度上抗议

segments.en: in some ways and I think it's given what wars has done as well the anchor I see the anchor in the short end is the Fed
segments.zh: 某种程度上，考虑到美联储的行动，短端锚是美联储

segments.en: and what the expectations are but the long end what could be that anchor what's driving the long end it's it's the need for premium
segments.zh: 但长端的锚是什么？驱动长端的是对溢价的需求

segments.en: because of the demand for funding and we've seen particularly from the private sector with AI infrastructure
segments.zh: 因为融资需求，尤其是私营部门对AI基础设施的需求

segments.en: it's reached the point where those big hyperscalers are no longer able to fund their needs they're built out as they're competing effectively for for market share
segments.zh: 大型云服务商已无法仅靠自身满足资金需求，它们正为市场份额竞争

segments.en: longer term we've seen this before in previous cycles with different technology as they're competing for for that market share
segments.zh: 长期看，以往周期中不同技术竞争市场份额时也出现过类似情况

segments.en: they've reached the point where they can no longer fund it out of revenue out of recurrent revenue so now they're coming to the market
segments.zh: 它们已无法用经常性收入来融资，所以转向市场

segments.en: it's putting demand on the market resources are always scarce financial resources are scarce
segments.zh: 这给市场带来需求，金融资源总是稀缺的

segments.en: remember coming out of 2025 the Fed itself was had a process of quantitative tightening
segments.zh: 记得2025年美联储曾进行量化紧缩

segments.en: and and although that's over the the image of that the shadow of that is still working its way through
segments.zh: 虽然已结束，但其阴影仍在影响市场

segments.en: so that's led to the term premium at the same time of course we're all concerned about the fiscal deficit and the long term funding of that
segments.zh: 这推高了期限溢价，同时我们都担心财政赤字及其长期融资

segments.en: and what we're seeing in terms of the Treasury's activity it can move the maturity profile around but it can't get away from the fact that that debt needs funding
segments.zh: 财政部可以调整期限结构，但无法回避债务需要融资的事实

segments.en: you think it's pushing investors away from the bond markets or is that lowering money back in because I think the bottom scale is really because the demand is there anyway
segments.zh: 你认为这是把投资者赶出债市，还是吸引资金回流？我认为根本原因是需求就在那里

segments.en: the demand is there and you know investors are keen to participate because there are opportunities to pick up spread
segments.zh: 需求存在，投资者也乐于参与，因为有机会获得利差

segments.en: taking insurance company like ourselves we are constantly being approached by big issuers both in the public and private markets
segments.zh: 像我们这样的保险公司，经常有大型发行人在公开和私募市场找上门

segments.en: a lot of these companies although they can go to the public markets prefer to do private deals that they prefer to you know have the governance tailored to what they need
segments.zh: 许多公司虽可进入公开市场，但更倾向于私募交易，以便定制治理结构
